args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring and FIN-212 spec call for banker's rounding, but the
implementation incorrectly used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch the import and
quantize call to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so tests/test_money.py passes
(e.g. 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66).

args.head: fix/fin-212-round-half-even
args.title: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` was rounding with `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though the FIN-212 spec (and its own docstring) call for banker's rounding.
- Switched the import and `quantize` call to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so amounts like 2.665 round to 2.66 while 2.675 rounds to 2.68.

## Why
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects ROUND_HALF_EVEN behavior.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit 08d3cd5 passed (all tests green, including `test_half_even`).

Fixes the FIN-212 rounding discrepancy.
